description: MainActivity class for an Android application, responsible for setting up the main interface, handling menu options, and constructing a display message using utility classes and external libraries.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity class that initializes the main view, manages menu options, and displays a customized message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets the layout and initializes the main TextView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, starts a new activity when the 'open_tv_index' action is selected.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message string by splitting, joining, and capitalizing text.
